usedFor: Freelo holds projects and Trello gets a board for each, since “Project Created” runs “Copy Board”.

bestTemplate.name: “Project Created” in Freelo, then “Copy Board” in Trello
bestTemplate.why: Each new project gets its own board copied from an existing one, so setup is the same every time.

watchOut: “Copy Board” needs an existing board to copy and an organization to put it in, so pick both in advance.
